failure_definition: Tibial tray fracture under cyclic loading, resulting in mechanical failure of the knee implant.
causal_mechanism: Mechanical fracture under cyclic loading, driven by stress concentration in high-load regions.
current_device_behavior: The Zimmer NexGen knee implant provides a stable and functional knee joint replacement.
failure_point: The high-stress regions of the tibial tray, specifically the stem junction or peripheral rim.
blocking_constraint: The need to maintain all other dimensions and material properties of the tibial tray while increasing its thickness in high-stress regions.
